title: Hear Only Eyes Again

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Sanity Bay, southeast veering southwest 4 or 5. Thundery showers. Moderate. ModerATE. Moderrrrraaate.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sanity Bay, southeast veering southwest 4 or 5. Thundery showers. Moderate. ModerATE. Moderrrrraaate.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Caladrius Zone, northeast 3 or 4. Occasional rain. Poor. Am I poor? Am? Eye. Ha ha. That's good. Aye aye. Ha ha.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Caladrius Zone, northeast 3 or 4. Occasional rain. Poor. Am I poor? Am? Eye. Ha ha. That's good. Aye aye. Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Fluke Rocks, northerly 7 to severe gale 9. Moderate icing. Not the good stuff like they use on donuts. Donuts. I remember them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fluke Rocks, northerly 7 to severe gale 9. Moderate icing. Not the good stuff like they use on donuts. Donuts. I remember them.
I hear you, auditory hallucination.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: That's what you always say. Siroc Vale, southwest 6 by 7, veering east. Toxic smog.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what you always say. Siroc Vale, southwest 6 by 7, veering east. Toxic smog.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: I am reading today's shipping forecast, brought to you by CurzoLive, the only news channel you can trust. Twenty-four hours a day, eight days a week.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am reading today's shipping forecast, brought to you by CurzoLive, the only news channel you can trust. Twenty-four hours a day, eight days a week.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: I've been reading the - Mountain Town, northwest 2 by 10, moderate - CurzoLive forecast for as long as I can remember. Moderate!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been reading the - Mountain Town, northwest 2 by 10, moderate - CurzoLive forecast for as long as I can remember. Moderate!

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Duck Gut Sound, south by south easterly, 7 by 12. Fair. That's right. All shipping. All the time. All the time. All the time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Duck Gut Sound, south by south easterly, 7 by 12. Fair. That's right. All shipping. All the time. All the time. All the time.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Nickel Point! Southwest gale 8 to storm 10! Veering, veering, veering, veering. Veering.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nickel Point! Southwest gale 8 to storm 10! Veering, veering, veering, veering. Veering.
Let's reply.
Patching you in.
Hello?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I am picking up the broadcast again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am picking up the broadcast again.
Let's hear it.
What broadcast?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The shipping forecast. You expressed an interest in it before. Transmitting now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The shipping forecast. You expressed an interest in it before. Transmitting now.
Can you hear me?
I'm not a hallucination.
What are you doing?
Without a break?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How long have you been doing this for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How long have you been doing this for?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How long have you been doing this for?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How long have you been doing this for?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I looked up CurzoLive. I'm afraid they closed down over two hundred years ago.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I looked up CurzoLive. I'm afraid they closed down over two hundred years ago.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So why is he still broadcasting?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So why is he still broadcasting?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So why is he still broadcasting?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So why is he still broadcasting?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: My guess? Someone forgot to tell him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My guess? Someone forgot to tell him.
Should we tell him?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It's up to you. Perhaps if we find him physically, we can see if he is in any distress.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's up to you. Perhaps if we find him physically, we can see if he is in any distress.
Sounds like a plan.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nah, he seems fine. Leave him to it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nah, he seems fine. Leave him to it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Nah, he seems fine. Leave him to it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Nah, he seems fine. Leave him to it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As you wish.
Anybody listening?
Am I hallucinating him then?
